newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Wednesday as buyers and sellers continue locked in a standoff situation, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers with bids at $66.00 per cwt and asking prices $68.00-$69.00.
Last established market was a light test Friday at $68.00. There were 22,000 head confirmed for the week to date including 21,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
